instruction: Set VLC as the default application for playing video files on this system.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting VLC as the default video player. This can be done through system settings or by right-clicking a video file and selecting 'Open With' > 'Set as default'. Evaluator checks the system's default video player setting using xdg-mime.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly uses 'xdg-mime query default video/mp4' to extract the system's default video player application, which is the appropriate method for Linux systems
Metric logic properly checks if 'vlc' appears in the result string (case-insensitive) and returns correct scores based on the expected configuration
Data flow is correct: getter extracts the right state (default video player), metric compares the right aspect (whether VLC is default), and expected value matches the instruction requirement
Complete instruction coverage: evaluator verifies the single requirement of setting VLC as default video player
Edge cases handled appropriately: command failures return 'unknown', None/empty results are safely handled with conditional checks, case-insensitive matching handles desktop file name variations

Metric parameter handling is correct: uses 'expected.get("is_vlc_default", True)' to directly access the rules dictionary without incorrectly accessing 'expected.get("rules")' or 'expected.get("type")'
Expected value is semantically correct: 'is_vlc_default: true' accurately represents the task requirement
